a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs two operate rounds before anyone takes, so it only has about a 4% chance of finishing. Whoever is short when a storm hits is lost, so the plan almost surely loses us both. I'm planning to take 4 in round 1 and won't hide it. If you'd rather work out something else, like me returning cells afterwards to help you if we get more rounds, tell me and I'll respond honestly.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round, because waiting two rounds under 80% storm odds is close to certain loss. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry.
